The Geely EX2 is an electric hatchback built for modern city life. Packed with smart technology, comprehensive safety features, and 36 storage spaces, there’s plenty of room to play with. And wait until you see the frunk…

## GEELY EX2 DESIGN AT A GLANCE

The Geely EX2 has been crafted in perfect ratio: the proportions and curves result in a car that’s both attractive and aerodynamic. Design highlights include feather inspired headlights, semi-concealed door handles and 16” alloy wheels.

## Safety features of the Geely EX2

Our Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) provide four layers of active protection to anticipate risks,  maintain a set distance, and support your driving experience.

### ADAPTIVE CRUISE CONTROL

Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) keeps a set distance by matching your speed to the traffic ahead, helping you drive comfortably and safely on motorways or in slow-moving traffic.

### AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKING

Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB) monitors the road ahead and applies the brakes if a collision risk is detected, helping to reduce or avoid impact.

### LANE DEPARTURE WARNING

Lane Departure Warning (LDW) alerts you when the vehicle begins to drift from its lane, helping you stay safely on course.

### LANE CHANGE ASSIST

Monitors blind spots and warns you of vehicles approaching in adjacent lanes when changing lanes.

### DOOR OPEN WARNING

Warns the driver if a moving obstacle is detected when opening the door.

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

### Is the Geely EX2 fully electric?

Yes, the Geely EX2 is a fully-electric hatchback. If you’re on the move, simply make use of public charging stations across the country—we’ll even help you locate them with the [Octopus Electroverse app.](https://electroverse.com/partnerships/geely-uk)

We also offer a range of home charging options for your EV through our [partners](https://www.geelyauto.co.uk/partnerships). For more information, simply [simply get in touch with an authorised Geely dealer.](https://www.geelyauto.co.uk/find-dealer)

### Does the Geely EX2 come with a charging cable?

Yes, the Geely EX2 comes with a Type 2 Mode 3 charging cable. Additional charging cables and accessories can be found on our [Accessories page.](https://www.geelyauto.co.uk/ownership/accessories)

### What boot capacity does the Geely EX2 have?

The Geely EX2 comes with 375 litres of boot space as standard. If you fold down the rear seats, this increases to up to 1,320 litres—making it ideal for fitting your luggage, getting everything packed for a weekend adventure, or simply for that big shopping trip.

### How much is the Geely EX2 to buy?

The Geely EX2 Pro starts from £20,990, the Max starts from £23,490, and the Ultra starts from £25,490.

To find out more, [get in touch with your local dealer.](https://www.geelyauto.co.uk/find-dealer)

### What are the Geely EX2 dimensions?

The Geely EX2 is 1,580mm in height, 4,135mm in length and 1,805mm in width. Featuring 5 seats, the Geely EX2 is spacious and practical.

### What wheel drive is the Geely EX2?

The Geely EX2 is rear-wheel drive—delivering balanced handling and precise control.

### What is Personal Contract Purchase?

Personal Contract Purchase is a finance plan that allows you to defer part of the cost of the vehicle until the end of the agreement, reducing the regular monthly payments. The deferred element known as the optional final payment is based upon the likely value of the vehicle at the end of the agreement and is set by the finance company based upon the annual mileage selected. At the end of the term you have the option to hand the vehicle back, part exchange it or pay a final payment to take ownership of the vehicle. If you choose to hand the vehicle back excess mileage and damage charges may apply.
